(async () => { const out = []; const n = document.querySelectorAll('.step-map li').length; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { document.querySelectorAll('.step-map li button')[i].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 350)); window.scrollTo(0,0); const nav = document.querySelector('.step-nav').getBoundingClientRect().bottom; const fig = document.querySelector('.iso-art').getBoundingClientRect().bottom; out.push((i+1) + ':' + Math.round(nav) + '/' + Math.round(fig)); } return out.join(' '); })()
